title: DeepSeek Harness gets a Pollinations setup command
summary:
DeepSeek Harness gained a setup command, GLM-5.3 got a new route, and model limits became easier to inspect.

The team added `polli harness dsh on|off|status` to the CLI. It connects DeepSeek Harness to Pollinations text models and, by default, adds hosted MCP tools for image, audio, and video. The coding-harness guide now follows the same setup and removal flow.

The team moved GLM-5.3 and its `z-ai/glm-5.3` alias from an OpenRouter route to Fireworks. Reasoning remains mandatory, GLM-5.3 is no longer marked paid-only, and GLM-5.3 Flash keeps its existing route.

Quest contributions added declared context-window and video-duration limits to catalog tooltips, plus naming tips for community model publishers. A separate announcement clarification says publisher-and-model-name IDs take effect September 7 at 14:00 UTC; the new IDs already work, and existing IDs will continue working.

highlights.title: Connect DeepSeek Harness
highlights.text: Use `polli harness dsh on` to connect DeepSeek Harness to Pollinations text models and add image, audio, and video tools through MCP. [Get the CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

highlights.title: GLM-5.3 on Fireworks
highlights.text: Try reasoning with `z-ai/glm-5.3`, now routed directly through Fireworks and no longer marked paid-only. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=z-ai/glm-5.3).

highlights.title: Model limits at a glance
highlights.text: Check declared context windows and video-duration limits in model catalog tooltips before choosing a model. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).
